subject.title: Control UI file browser: show Gateway and nodes at the super-root

question: Should operator-admin session creation expose paired-node directory inventories through a declared read-only node command?
rationale: The repository has an appropriate generic node capability seam, but approving remote filesystem metadata disclosure and its operator scope requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve narrow node browsing
options.body: Add a declared read-only command with pairing allowlist enforcement, mixed-version gating, atomic node/cwd selection, and real paired-node proof.

options.title: Keep Gateway-only browsing
options.body: Retain manual node cwd entry and avoid exposing remote directory inventories in the Control UI.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow node browsing
recommendation.body: Add a declared read-only command with pairing allowlist enforcement, mixed-version gating, atomic node/cwd selection, and real paired-node proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent Gateway-only browser and opened this focused follow-up, making them the clearest owner for the intended product and trust boundary.
